records.note: God establishes believers by firm speech in life and afterlife; not equated with biblical rooted-tree or steadfastness motifs without exact witness.
People exchange divine favor for unbelief and lead their people to ruin; generic ingratitude and leadership motifs are not sufficient to identify earlier literary source.
Hell named as destination for the group of 14:28; earlier Jewish and Christian eschatological punishment traditions require precise witnesses and differentiated Gehenna terminology.
Setting rivals beside God and misleading others; shared anti-idolatry doctrine alone cannot establish a specific earlier text; source-specific legal and prophetic texts require direct checking.
